notes.title: Music Fix up
notes.content:
The music was quitting after the first song.
The jump scare was not using the audio that it should have.

Both of these problems should now be resolved.

notes.title: Villain Update: We made the bad guy spookier.
notes.content:
Modified the villain's main area actions so it will follow you if you sprint.
Also made it look significantly better.

notes.title: Bug Fix! Show Little Less E
notes.content: The standard "E" to interact drawing that appears when Val is close enough to interact with objects should now only show up in full color once she can actually interact. Otherwise there is a more greyed out version to indicate that you can interact with this item once you have something else or wait for something to finish.

notes.title: MAZE MAZE MAZE MAZE
notes.content:
There are now four random maze set ups that you can encounter while going through different play throughs.

Also fixed some weirdness with going up stairs in the Cidar barn.

notes.title: Some Smol updates!
notes.content:
- Added a StopWatch Feature, so you feel stress about completing the game quickly.
- Fixed a game breaking bug where in the upstairs Cidar barn one would not get jumpscared.
- Reduced distance to walk away from the key before it will start following.
- Disabled jumpscare happening from opening 3 outhouses in "spoopy" mode.
- Added a global.random_seed value.
- Added the villain to roam the main area. And he might chase you.

notes.title: WORMS WORMS WORMS WORMS WORMS
notes.content:
Get yourself as many worms as you'd like!

They can now help more with your fishing endeavors! ;)
